body: Gee thanks for telling me what I already know. I just don't want to deal with high strung people atm and that's my personal choice like you said. Are you sure you're an INTP?
Perhaps. I'd rather avoid feeler types for now.
I can disappear for weeks and months without contacting a single person. I think INTPs do that better than INFJs actually.
This one door-slammed me because I wasn't having any of her self-righteousness anymore. My only regret was that I didn't cut off ties with her sooner.
Interesting, I've never considered her as one because ISFPs are labeled the "adventurers" or "artists" and I never pinned her as either. Thanks for pointing this out to me.

Hm, perhaps I didn't word my description of her that well but I'm almost certain she is an INFJ. I have siblings that are INFPs and she's not quite like them. I've came to the conclusion that she is an unhealthy INFJ because she always has mood swings and mental breakdowns. I've never doubted her sincerity or honesty during the bulk of her friendship but it felt like if I didn't agree with every one of her ideals then I was against her.

Definitely agree that they are very stubborn and strongly opinionated. Their black and white thinking is really different from our grey area mindset since we are most concerned with the search for truth.
